content: This run of the TECA Builder attempted to parse requirements, generate components, validate project artifacts, and publish to a repository. However, critical outputs from Generate Components and Organize Project were missing, causing validation to fail and repository publish to abort. No validation or publishing actions occurred. All lessons learned were documented for process improvement.
